Faraday (https://faraday.so/) | Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Backend) | New York City (Chinatown) | ONSITE | $160K–$200K + seed-stage equity

Faraday is automating the back office for the $600B home services industry (HVAC, plumbers, electricians). Contractors are buried in essential paperwork — permits, warranties, rebates — and our AI agents handle these complex workflows so projects stay on track and contractors get paid faster.

We've grown 300% in 9 months and partnered with some of the leading US home service brands. Backed by top-tier VCs, we're a 10-person team operating out of Chinatown, NYC. What you'll do:

Build and scale our AI agent platform and internal tools Ship features end-to-end, working closely with customers Own backend services, APIs, and integrations (ServiceTitan, etc.)

What we're looking for:

5+ years full-stack experience Proficient in TypeScript/JavaScript, cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) Familiarity with AI/LLMs or eagerness to learn fast Startup experience (founder or early-stage engineer)

Benefits: Medical/dental/vision, flexible PTO, meaningful equity. Apply: https://jobs.gem.com/faraday/am9icG9zdDqmTBDxS17nKvhUlj6NuRr...
